blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/.

PET-DINOv2-2D使用每个骨干相同的轻量级头部,尽管训练前的数据要少得多,但在三个下行的PET任务上,PET匹配或表现均超过:正常/异常分类,损伤分化和无复发存活预后. 它的优势最大,因为很少有标签可用,这表明PET预训会给出更多可转移,标签效率更高的特征. 守则可在https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Self-supervised learning (SSL) has produced the first medical-imaging foundation models: a frozen encoder serving many downstream tasks through a small head. One pre-training objective usually suits only one task family: Wald et al. [ 25 ] show contrastive pre-training favours classification while generative pre-training favours segmentation. DINO [ 4 ] , and especially DINOv2 [ 20 ] , addresses this by learning features for both global and dense tasks.
Baharoon et al. [ 2 ] confirm this: a frozen natural-image DINOv2 matches or beats every baseline on X-ray, CT and MRI, and is the only model to generalise across tasks.
blocks.zh:
自我监督的学习(SSL)产生了第一个医学成像基础模型:一个被冷冻的编码器通过一个小头来服务许多下游的任务. 一个训练前目标通常只适合一个任务家庭: 华德等. [25] 显示对比性的培训前倾向于分类,而遗传性的培训前倾向于分化。 DINO [4],特别是DINOv2 [20],通过学习全球性和密集性任务的特点来解决这个问题.
巴哈罗翁等. [2]证实这一点:被冻结的自然相像DINov2匹配或击败了X射线,CT和核磁共振上的每一个基线,是跨任务通用的唯一模型.

blocks.en: PET is primarily an oncological modality: its functional uptake signal is used to detect, delineate and assess tumours, making a general-purpose PET foundation model particularly valuable. However, this cross-modality transfer breaks down on PET: natural-image DINO features that excel on X-ray/CT/MRI lose ground on PET/CT, attributed to PET’s functional rather than structural signal [ 17 ] . Pre-training DINO directly on PET has barely been explored: to our knowledge only two works do so [ 16 , 13 ] , each on a single task, and Lin et al. train on UDPET [ 15 ] alone ( ≈ 1500 \approx 1500 scans, 2 scanners). Other SSL PET encoders likewise report gains on only one task [ 10 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh: PET主要是肿瘤学模式:其功能吸收信号被用来检测,分出并评估肿瘤,使通用的PET基础模型特别有价值. 然而,这种跨模式转移在PET上破裂:在X光/CT/MRI上表现优异的自然成像DINO特征在PET/CT上失去基础,这归因于PET的功能而不是结构信号[17]. 在PET上直接进行预训的DINO几乎没有被探索:据我们所知,只有两部作品这样做[16,13],每部作品都是单项任务,而Lin等人. 仅UDPET[15]号列车(XQ 1500\约1500扫描,2个扫描仪). 其他SSL PET编码器同样只报告一项任务[10,21]的进展.

blocks.en: Testing whether this gap reflects a structural-vs-functional or merely a natural-vs-medical shift requires more than a single natural-image baseline. We therefore (1) pre-train our own DINOv2 on a dedicated, largely open-source PET dataset, and (2) benchmark natural-image, radiology (CT/MRI), and PET encoders across three core oncological tasks: lesion triage (detection), tumour-burden segmentation (delineation), and recurrence-free survival (prognosis) (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 测试这一差距是否反映结构-vs-功能或仅仅是自然-vs-医学转变,需要不止一个自然成像基线。 因此,我们 (1) 预先培训我们自己的DINOv2 专门、基本上开源的PET数据集,以及 (2) 基准自然成像、放射学(CT/MRI)和PET编码器,它们涉及三个核心肿瘤学任务:损伤分解(检测)、肿瘤负担分解(分解)和无复发生存(预测)(图1)。

blocks.en: Our Contributions:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献:

blocks.en: • We present the first PET-pre-trained DINOv2 that is evaluated beyond one downstream task (on patient-level classification, dense prediction, and survival prognosis) and benchmarked head-to-head against natural-image and radiology (CT/MRI) foundation models under a single frozen-encoder protocol. • We pre-train on multiple PET datasets rather than a single source, a prerequisite for a model intended to generalise as a foundation model. • We show that strong downstream performance is achievable with a frozen encoder and a lightweight head, on both global and dense tasks.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们提出第一个经过PET前训练的DINOv2,它评估范围超出一项下游任务(关于病人一级的分类、密集预测和生存预测),并以一个单一的冷冻编码器协议作为基准头到头对照自然成像和放射学(CT/MRI)基础模型。 我们预先培训多个PET数据集,而不是单一来源,这是旨在将模型概括为基础模型的先决条件。 我们显示,通过冷冻编码器和轻量级头,在全球性和密集性任务上,下游强有力的业绩是可以实现的。

blocks.en: We present the first PET-pre-trained DINOv2 that is evaluated beyond one downstream task (on patient-level classification, dense prediction, and survival prognosis) and benchmarked head-to-head against natural-image and radiology (CT/MRI) foundation models under a single frozen-encoder protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们提出第一个经过PET前训练的DINOv2,它被评价在一项下游任务(关于病人一级的分类、密集预测和存活预测)之外,并且根据单一的冷冻编码程序将头对头与自然成像和放射学(CT/MRI)的基础模型作为基准。

blocks.en: We pre-train on multiple PET datasets rather than a single source, a prerequisite for a model intended to generalise as a foundation model.
blocks.zh: 我们预先对多个PET数据集进行训练,而不是单一的源头,这是拟将通用为基础模型的模型的先决条件.

blocks.en: We show that strong downstream performance is achievable with a frozen encoder and a lightweight head, on both global and dense tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,通过冷冻编码器和轻量级头,在全球性和密集性任务上,下游强有力的业绩是可以实现的。

blocks.en: 1.1 DINOv2 pre-training and baselines
blocks.zh: 1.1 DINov2 预训和基线

blocks.en:
DINO [ 4 ] trains a student ViT against an
EMA teacher on the CLS tokens only, giving strong image-level but weaker dense
features. One of the additions of DINOv2 [ 20 ] is the iBOT [ 27 ] loss on masked patch tokens, helping the features serve both global and dense tasks. We build on DINOv2, as the newer DINOv3 [ 22 ] is designed for a billion-image, billion-parameter regime less suited to the smaller datasets common in medical imaging.

blocks.en: 1.2 PET pre-training data
blocks.zh: 1.2 PET培训前数据

blocks.en:
No large-scale open-source PET dataset comparable to CheXpert [ 11 ] or RadImageNet in radiology exists yet. We therefore train PET-DINOv2-2D on existing open-source PET datasets plus collected private data, all in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki.
The datasets used for pre-training are listed in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh:
在放射学中尚不存在与CheXpert[11]或RadImageNet相媲美的大规模开源PET数据集. 因此,我们根据《赫尔辛基宣言》,对PET-DINOv2-2D进行关于现有的开源PET数据集以及所收集的私人数据的培训。

blocks.en: Table 1: Pre-training data
blocks.zh: 表1:培训前数据

blocks.en:
The complete pre-training data consists of 4194 3D PET volumes. To pre-train a 2D
model on them we use Maximum Intensity Projections (MIPs): 4 oblique MIPs per
volume, giving 16,776 2D images. To our knowledge, MIPs have not been used for SSL
pre-training before. We choose them for PET specifically: tumour uptake typically
stands out above healthy-organ background in a projection, MIPs keep one image per
patient so patient-level labels stay intact, and nuclear medicine physicians
routinely read MIPs for quick triage. A projection also concentrates signal: most of a single PET slice is low-uptake
background, whereas each MIP captures the whole volume’s uptake. The main trade-off is a hiding effect, where a small lesion behind a high-uptake
organ can be projected away. Pre-training on individual axial, coronal and sagittal
slices avoids this, but has to handle the per-slice sparsity, which we leave as
future work.

blocks.en: 1.3 Classification
blocks.zh: 1.3 分类

blocks.en: Data
blocks.zh: 数据

blocks.en: The downstream cohort is a private multicentre FDG-PET dataset with 1,911 patients from three clinical centres. All data was collected in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki. This cohort is disjoint from the pre-training data (no shared patients or scans), so the classification comparison is free of pre-training leakage.
blocks.zh: 下游组群是一个私人多中心FDG-PET数据集,共有来自三个临床中心的1,911名患者. 所有数据都是根据《赫尔辛基宣言》收集的。 这个组群与训练前数据脱节(没有共享患者或扫描),因此分类比较没有训练前渗出.

blocks.en: Each scan has a patient-level binary label (normal vs. abnormal); Table 2 gives the distribution and image specifications per centre. Labels were assigned per centre, with negatives followed up for six months to rule out missed findings. We hold out a centre- and label-stratified test set of 191 patients (10%), tune with 5-fold cross-validation on the rest, then re-train with 8 seeds on the full training set and report on the test set.
blocks.zh: 每次扫描都有一个患者级别的二进制标签(正常对异常);表2给出了每个中心的分布和图像规格. 每个中心都配有标签,6个月来跟踪底片,以排除遗漏的调查结果。 我们保留了一套由191名病人(10%)组成的中央和标签级测试组,其余部分有5倍的交叉验证,然后在全部培训组上再用8个种子进行再培训,并报告测试组的情况。

blocks.en: Architecture of the head
blocks.zh: 头部结构

blocks.en:
Every backbone is evaluated with the same protocol on its frozen, cached token
features: • Pooling: GTV-masked mean over patch tokens, then mean over the MIP
views, giving one vector per patient. • Reduction + fusion: PCA ( 16 16 components) on the image features, with or without
concatenated z-score-standardised clinical covariates and log-MTV. • Risk model: a penalised Cox proportional-hazards model [ 5 ] trained on the neg. Cox partial
log-likelihood, mapping the fused vector to a scalar log-risk. • Train/val split: the PCA, clinical-feature standardisation, and
missing-value imputation are all fit on the training fold only, then applied
unchanged to the validation fold. We use centre-grouped 5-fold cross-validation (no centre in both train and
validation), matching HECKTOR’s unseen-centre test split. As censoring is heavy and
centre-dependent, we report Uno’s IPCW C-index [ 23 ] as primary metric, alongside Harrell’s C [ 8 ] .
Each backbone yields one pooled out-of-fold risk score per patient, and
between-encoder differences are tested with a paired patient-level bootstrap
( B = 2000 B{=}2000 ; 95 % 95\% CIs, two-sided p p ) [ 6 ] .

blocks.en: The HECKTOR 2025 challenge [ 9 ] reported best held-out-centre RFS C-indices of 0.658 0.658 and 0.602 0.602 (first and second place), both from fully end-to-end 3D PET/CT encoders fused with clinical variables; imaging alone was deemed insufficient. blocks.en: 3 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 3 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 self-supervised on 2D PET, pre-trained on maximum-intensity projections from several PET datasets. Keeping every encoder frozen behind the same lightweight heads, we compared PET pre-training against the natural-image DINOv2 and radiology-pre-trained OmniRad on classification, segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. PET pre-training gave the strongest features whenever labels were limited: it led classification in the low-data regime, outperformed both non-PET encoders on segmentation under a lightweight skip-free decoder, and gave the only image-only prognostic features matching the clinical baseline. OmniRad (CT/MRI) tracked natural-image DINOv2 throughout, while its pre-training dataset is also substantially smaller (factor 100). The transfer gap reflects overall a structural-vs-functional shift rather than a generic natural-vs-medical one.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PET-DINOv2-2D,这是第一个在2D PET上自我监督的DINov2,从几个PET数据集中预先对最大强度的预测进行了训练. 将所有编码器冻结在相同的轻量级头后, 我们比较了PET预训 与自然成像 DINOv2 和放射学预训 OmniRad 关于分类,分化和无复发存活预后。 当标签有限时,PET预训给出了最强的特征:它带动了低数据系统中的分解,在分解上表现优于两个非PET编码器在轻量级跳跃自由解码器下的分解,并给出了唯一与临床基线相匹配的只有图像的预想特征. OmniRad(CT/MRI)跟踪了整个自然图像DINOv2,而其预训数据集也大大小了(因素100). 转移差距反映了总体结构-vs-功能转变,而不是一般的自然-vs-医疗转变。

blocks.en: Our study has three main limitations. First, HECKTOR (the prognosis set) was part of PET-DINOv2-2D’s label-free pre-training but not the baselines’, so prognosis is not leakage-free; we treat it as corroborating, and the two leakage-free tasks (classification on a disjoint cohort, and DeepPSMA segmentation, absent from pre-training) show the same ranking, supporting our claim that the advantage is not a memorisation artefact. Second, our encoder uses patch size 16 against the baselines’ 14 in accordance with DINOv1 and DINOv3, but per the DINO literature a larger patch should if anything weaken performance, meaning it does not explain its lead. Third, our PET pre-training set is comparatively small and MIP-based; future work includes slice-based pre-training to increase 2D diversity and remove the mismatch with the segmentation input.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有三个主要的局限性。 首先,HECKTOR(预后集)是PET-DINOv2-2D的无标签预训的一部分,但不是基线的一部分,因此预后不无渗漏;我们视之为确证;而两项无渗漏任务(分解于脱节组群,而DeepPSMA分解在预训之外)则显示同样的排名,支持了我们的主张,即优势并非是失忆活动能. 第二,我们的编码器根据DINov1和DINov3,使用16相比基线的补丁大小14个,但根据DINO文献,如果有什么东西削弱性能,则应该有一个更大的补丁,这意味着它不能解释它的领先性能。 第三,我们的PET预训集比较小并基于MIP;今后的工作包括以切片预训来增加2D多样性并去除与分解输入的不匹配.

blocks.en: Overall, the pre-training domain matters for PET: its functional signal less well captured by natural-image or CT/MRI pre-training, and an in-domain PET DINOv2 transfers better across tasks despite far less pre-training data.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,培训前域对PET很重要:其功能信号不太被自然成像或CT/MRI预训所捕捉,而且尽管培训前数据少得多,但域内PET DINov2在任务间转移更好.
